title: Serial Interface

fields.name: file
fields.description: Absolute path to the device entry, e.g: /dev/ttyS0

fields.name: bitrate
fields.description: The bitrate for the communication, e.g: 9600, 38400, 115200, etc

fields.name: min_bytes
fields.description: The serial interface will expect at least Min_Bytes to be available before to process the message (default: 1)

fields.name: separator
fields.description: Allows to specify a separator string that's used to determinate when a message ends.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify the format of the incoming data stream.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: The serial input plugin, allows to retrieve messages/data from a Serial interface.
